titulo_es: An imaginary situation · Possibility and condition

texto: «Hvis» introduces a condition. In an open possibility the present is usually used; in an imaginary situation the preterito may appear with «ville» in the main. It takes care of the context, not just the verbal form.
See what form the relationship expresses and return to the sentence to check it.

frases.da: Hvis hun havde mere tid, ville hun læse rapporten.
frases.es: Si tuviera más tiempo, leería el informe.
frases.en: If I had more time, I'd read the report.

frases.da: Hun ville også tale med naboerne.
frases.en: I'd also talk to the neighbors.
